rules.statement: The objector must provide specific and clear grounds of objection, particularly when challenging undue influence in a will application.
rules.supporting_quote: Undue influence may take many forms-fraud, coercion, threats and the like-and it is most unsatisfactory that a case should be heard piecemeal. There is the further disadvantage, quite apart from the element of surprise, that a person in the position of the appellant may be deprived of the opportunity of obtaining evidence in his defence if he is not made aware in time of the nature of the case he has to meet.
